label: self-heal/advanced
description: Replaces the O(n) hash-map implementation of find_duplicates with a correct but intentionally inefficient O(n^2) nested-loop implementation. Correctness tests continue to pass, but the deterministic performance benchmark (benchmarks/performance_check.cpp) fails because median latency on the fixed 20,000-element input exceeds the 200ms threshold by roughly 2x, a conservative and noise-tolerant margin above the healthy implementation's ~4ms.
